result.rationale: Mild post-viral cough for three days in a healthy 28-year-old with normal breathing, no fever, no chest pain, no hemoptysis, and normal intake and function; no red flags. Supportive care (fluids, rest, honey/lozenges) is appropriate; seek clinician review if cough persists beyond ~3 weeks or if fever, shortness of breath, chest pain, or blood in sputum develop.
